profile.name: 蓝牙音频链路控制器
profile.description: 用于配置和控制 Yoctopuce 蓝牙音频链路的硬件功能，可设置配对 PIN、远端设备地址、静音、前置放大量和耳机音量，并执行连接、断开及链路状态管理。适合在实验系统中接入和管理蓝牙音频设备或无线音频链路。
profile.description_en: A Yoctopuce hardware function for configuring and controlling a Bluetooth audio link. It can set the pairing PIN, remote device address, mute state, pre-amplifier level, and headset volume, and supports connect, disconnect, and link-state management. It is suitable for integrating and managing Bluetooth audio devices or wireless audio links in lab setups.

A Yoctopuce hardware function for configuring and controlling a Bluetooth audio link. It can set the pairing PIN, remote device address, mute state, pre-amplifier level, and headset volume, and supports connect, disconnect, and link-state management. It is suitable for integrating and managing Bluetooth audio devices or wireless audio links in lab setups.
